description: This file provides FFI (Foreign Function Interface) implementations for TPM-related functions, including HMAC calculation and logging, used in the Android Open Source Project. It interacts with TPM resource management and logging facilities.

methods.name: tpm_hmac
methods.description: Calculates an HMAC using the TPM resource manager and copies the result into the provided buffer.

methods.name: secure_env_log
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified severity, file, and line number using Android's base logging system.
